name: EyeQ
tagline: Watches care settings on camera to flag possible caregiver abuse of people who cannot report it.
problem: People with cognitive disabilities, dementia or young children may be unable to report abuse.
solution: Detection models analyse footage for concerning interactions and notify guardians, with records stored locally.
demo_moment: Team-described: a flagged interaction triggers a guardian alert.

why_it_stood_out.claim: Won “Best Social Good Hack - Bitcamp” among 223 submissions.
Speaks for people who cannot report harm.

lessons: Name the vulnerable group and the harm precisely.
